title: Production serving: no Vite dev server, DATA_DIR outside repo, NODE_ENV=production, launchd
description: Why: pnpm dev serves the repo via Vite /@fs (verified 200 for pnpm-lock.yaml over https://rakazo.czaku.com); NODE_ENV=development disables auth rate limiting and secrets-guard. Do: (1) pnpm build for web; Caddy (~/dev/rakazo-setup/caddy/Caddyfile) serves apps/web/dist statically and proxies /api /rpc /novnc /events to 127.0.0.1:3100 — keep the authenticated screen proxy routes working; (2) .env NODE_ENV=production, DATA_DIR=/Users/luke/Library/Application Support/rakazo/data (migrate existing ./data), Better Auth secure cookies on the https origin; (3) launchd agents com.rakazo.api + com.rakazo.worker (KeepAlive, logs in ~/dev/rakazo-setup/.logs) replacing nohup pnpm dev; update start-rakazo.sh + INSTALL-LOG.md. AC (runtime): curl https://rakazo.czaku.com/@fs/… → 404; /health ok; login works from MacBook and iPhone app; a bot run completes; launchctl list shows both agents running; reboot-safe documented.
